identificationModule.briefTitle: Triple Therapy for Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting in Laparoscopic Gastrointestinal Surgery
identificationModule.officialTitle: Triple Combination of Fosaprepitant, Dexamethasone and Palonosetron Versus Combination of Dexamethasone and Palonosetron for the Prevention of Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting in Patients Undergoing Laparoscopic Gastrointestinal Surgery

leadSponsor.name: Sixth Affiliated Hospital, Sun Yat-sen University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) are common in patients, especially in patients at high risk. PONV may result in prolonged hospital stay and threaten patients' life. Because the etiology of PONV is very complex, there is an increasing focus on combining antiemetics from different classes for PONV prophylaxis. Fosaprepitant is a neurokinin-1 (NK-1) receptor antagonist to prevent PONV. Palonosetron is a 5-HT3 receptor antagonist with high efficacy and sustained action for PONV prophylaxis. Dexamethasone belongs to corticosteroid and also has the ability to reduce the incident of PONV. This study aims to use the combination of these three drugs in high-risk patients to test whether triple therapy is better than combination of palonosetron and dexamethasone to prevent PONV.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This trial is a prospective, randomized controlled study with blinded participant, care provider, investigator, and outcomes assessor. 1154 patients aged 18 to 75 years undergoing laparoscopic gastrointestinal surgery will be enrolled.Triple therapy of palonosetron and dexamethasone plus fosaprepitant will be administered in the intervention group, and double therapy of palonosetron and dexamethasone will be used in the control group. The anxiety of patients will be evaluated. The primary outcome is proportion of participants with PONV during the first 24 postoperative hours. Secondary outcomes are as follow: proportion of participants with PONV,emetic episodes, nausea, with rescue antiemetic medication; the scores of QOR-15; pain scores;time to first flatus after surgery; time to first defecation after surgery; recovery time; health related quality of life; proportion of participants with adverse events.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants with PONV during the first 24 postoperative hours
primaryOutcomes.description: PONV is defined as nausea, retching or vomiting
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from operation completion to 24-hour after surgery (up to 24 hours)

secondaryOutcomes.description: PONV is defined as nausea, retching or vomiting
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: calculated at 24-hour, 72-hour, 120-hour after surgery(daily recorded up to 120 hours after surgery)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants with emetic episodes
secondaryOutcomes.description: Emetic episodes are defined as retching or vomiting or both
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: calculated at 24-hour, 72-hour, 120-hour after surgery(daily recorded up to 120 hours after surgery)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Nausea is defined as a feeling of the urge to vomit
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: calculated at 24-hour, 72-hour, 120-hour after surgery(daily recorded up to 120 hours after surgery)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants with rescue antiemetic medication
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: calculated at 24-hour, 72-hour, 120-hour after surgery(daily recorded up to 120 hours after surgery)

secondaryOutcomes.description: The severity of PONV is evaluated by a PONV impact scale score. Nausea intensity is scored as 1 ,2 ,3. In addition, vomiting intensity is scored as the number of vomits (0-2, or 3 if three or more vomits). Both scores together to obtain the PONV impact scale score
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: calculated at 24-hour, 72-hour, 120-hour after surgery(daily recorded up to 120 hours after surgery)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Postoperative recovery score using 15-item quality of recovery scoring system(QoR-15) during each subsequent evaluation period (up to 120 hours)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The QoR-15 comprises five subscales: pain, physical comfort, physical independence, psychological support, and emotional state. Each item is scored from 0 to 10, and the possible total score ranges from 0 to 150. A higher total score means better patient QoR.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: evaluated at 24-hour, 72-hour, 120-hour after surgery(up to 120 hours after surgery)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Pain scores are evaluated by numerical rating scale(NRS) from no pain(0) to most severe pain (10).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: evaluated at 24-hour, 72-hour, 120-hour after surgery(up to 120 hours after surgery)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to first flatus after surgery
secondaryOutcomes.description: Time length between operation completion and the first flatus
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: evaluated at the time of first exhaust after surgery(expected average of 3 days after surgery)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to first defecation after surgery
secondaryOutcomes.description: Time length between operation completion and the first defecation
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: evaluated at the time of the first defecation after surgery(expected average of 6 days after surgery

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to fulfill the criteria of hospital discharge (recovery time)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The ideal time point for discharge, which is also considered as recovery time.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from operation completion to fulfill the criteria of hospital discharge(expected 6 days )

secondaryOutcomes.description: Health related quality of life is measured by EQ-5D. Each EQ-5D health state can be coded into a five-digit number using the numbers 1 , 2 , and 3 to indicate the functional levels of the five dimensions.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: evaluated before surgery, at 120-hour and 30 days after surgery (up to 30 days）

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of patients with adverse events (up to 30 days after surgery)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from drug administration to 30 days (30 days)

otherOutcomes.measure: Concentration of materials in blood such as hormone and metabolic
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: evaluated before surgery, at the end of surgery
